limitations: These samples do not exhaust every optional parameter, nullable variant, region, conditional payload, error branch or upstream change.
Schema validation does not reject undeclared properties by default; they were checked separately and reported as documentation gaps.
Explicitly free-form provider-native objects, including TikTok product details, do not provide field-by-field guarantees.
The seven successful existing Facebook routes still lack AIsa candidate response schemas. Official JustOneAPI schemas leave data unconstrained.
Three legacy Facebook GET operations have requestParams type mismatches against official JustOneAPI schemas.
Facebook get-profile-id returned origin_bad_gateway HTTP 502 twice; its success response remains unverified.
privacy: No credentials, request IDs, fixture values, opaque cursors, raw response payloads or account balances are included.
